_comment: python3, not python. macOS has shipped no `python` since 12.3 and most modern Linux distros ship none either; command-not-found returns 127, which is not 2, so EVERY hook silently no-ops and the transcript looks identical to enforcement working. That single word was the difference between a governed agent and an ungoverned one.

PreToolUse._comment: The hole in v1: enforcement covered Bash only, so the agent could edit its own tests to make them pass, and edit its own hooks to stop being governed.

Notification._comment: Fires when the agent needs permission or input. This is the gate reaching your phone at 3am instead of the run idling until morning.
